jobs.name: hermes-daily-backup
jobs.prompt: Execute the Hermes backup script at /data/.hermes/scripts/backup.sh and report the results. Run the script, check its output, and summarize what was backed up (backup size, file count, skills count, memories count, sessions count). If the backup fails, report the error.

jobs.name: gulf-kharg-watch-daily
jobs.prompt: Daily Gulf-Kharg Watch situational awareness report. Load skill gulf-kharg-watch and generate a 24-hour report following the skill template. Sources: registered web sources, RSS feeds, Telegram channels (@VahidOnline, @javanmardi77, @khabari_18, @hormozgan_today). Rules: direct URL required for every event, HTTPS URLs only, separate publication time from claimed event time, classify social signals S0-SX, reposts of same content count as one signal, professional media not counted as social signals, single-source claims not in confirmed section, confirmed events require official source or 2+ independent sources, unresolved claims stay in under-review section, for Kharg/Booshehr absence of data does not equal absence of events, label analysis as assessment, use probability terms (very likely/likely/possible/unlikely), no live positions of forces/vessels/defense systems, no media downloads, max 12 sources and 8 events/signals, check Gregorian/Jalali dates and UTC/IRST conversion, check /data free space before and after. Output format: 1) Report time and period, 2) Executive summary max 8 lines, 3) Overall status (green/yellow/orange/red), 4) Confirmed events, 5) Claims under review, 6) Kharg and Bushehr status, 7) Hormozgan and Bandar Abbas status, 8) Strait of Hormuz and shipping security, 9) Social media fast signals, 10) Rejected/old/unrelated content, 11) 24-72 hour assessment, 12) Indicators to watch, 13) Report limitations, 14) Sources with direct URLs and confidence levels. Civilian recommendations only. Save report to /data/.hermes/reports/gulf-kharg-watch/latest.md and also as gulf-kharg-watch-YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-IRST.md. Keep only last 7 reports. Delete older reports.

jobs.name: crypto-portfolio-daily
jobs.prompt:
Daily Ourbit crypto portfolio collection and report.

Execute these steps in order:

Step 1 — Collect data:
Run: python3 ~/.hermes/skills/crypto-portfolio-watch/scripts/collect_ourbit.py
This fetches read-only data from Ourbit Spot and Futures APIs. Wait for completion.
If it fails with a Python crash or timeout, note the error but continue to Step 2.

Step 2 — Generate report:
Run: python3 ~/.hermes/skills/crypto-portfolio-watch/scripts/generate_report.py
This reads the normalized data and manifest to produce a daily markdown report.
The script automatically computes data quality from the manifest:
- Complete: all 5 endpoints success=true and complete=true
- Partial: at least one endpoint succeeded, but some failed or incomplete
- Failed: no endpoint succeeded
Always run this step — even if Step 1 completely failed. The report will reflect the actual quality.

Step 3 — Deliver report:
Read the file /data/.hermes/reports/crypto-portfolio-watch/latest.md and send its full content as the final response.

Behavior by scenario:
- ALL endpoints failed → report shows Overall status: Failed, all 5 endpoint rows with error_type/HTTP/API code, timestamps. Send this Failed report.
- SOME endpoints failed → report shows Overall status: Partial. Send this Partial report.
- ALL endpoints succeeded → report shows Overall status: Complete. Send this Complete report.

Never use vague phrases like "no data" alone. Always reference the manifest-derived quality status.

Security rules:
- Never display API Key, Secret, Signature, or auth headers
- Never execute POST, PUT, DELETE, or PATCH requests
- Never create orders, cancel orders, transfer, withdraw, or change leverage
- Never display raw private API responses
- Never modify other Skills or run self-improvement
